key_information_units.information: H1 2026 revenue grew by 7.2% to EUR 259.1 million, driven by service revenue growth of 6.7% and equipment sales revenue growth of 7.2%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'Interim service revenue grew by 6.7 per cent, equipment sales revenue increased by 7.2 per cent'; Financial highlights of H1 2026: 'Revenue grew by 7.2% and amounted to EUR 259.1 million (2025: EUR 241.7 million)'

key_information_units.information: H1 2026 EBITDA reached EUR 105.5 million (+9.5%), exceeding the EUR 100 million threshold for the first time, with an EBITDA margin of 40.7%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'interim EBITDA exceeded the threshold of EUR 100 million for the first time while EBITDA margin stood above 40 per cent'; Financial highlights of H1 2026: 'EBITDA increased by 9.5% and amounted to EUR 105.5 million (2025: EUR 96.3 million)'

key_information_units.information: Capital investments surged by 57.9% to EUR 37.5 million in H1 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights of H1 2026: 'Capital investments up by 57.9% and amounted to EUR 37.5 million (2025: EUR 23.7 million)'

key_information_units.information: Free cash flow generated from activities increased by 12.5% to EUR 64.1 million in H1 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'During January-June of 2026, free cash flow generated from our activities was 12.5 per cent higher than a year ago'; Financial highlights of H1 2026: 'Free cash flow went up by 12.5% and amounted to EUR 64.1 million (2025: EUR 57 million)'

key_information_units.information: Acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million in June 2026 and extended rights to use the 2,100 MHz frequency band for EUR 2 million to advance 5G network development.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'In June, we acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million... Also extended its right to use the 2,100 MHz frequency band... committing to pay another EUR 2 million for this right'

key_information_units.information: Planned EUR 7.1 million investment in 2026 for mobile network expansion, including construction of 50 new base stations, modernization of 300 existing sites, and upgrades to around 130 locations, with around 30 new base stations to be installed in 2027 under the state-funded RAIN program.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'during 2026 we will invest EUR 7.1 million in expanding our mobile network... construction of 50 new base stations, the modernization of 300 existing sites and the upgrade of around 130 additional locations... install around 30 new base stations in 2027 on towers built under the state-funded RAIN broadband infrastructure programme'

key_information_units.information: Mobile data traffic in Lithuania is growing by around 25% annually, one of the fastest growth rates in Europe, necessitating continuous investment in network capacity and quality.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'Mobile data traffic in Lithuania is growing by around 25 per cent annually, one of the fastest growth rates in Europe... consistently increases the load and requires continuous investment in capacity and quality of the network'

key_information_units.information: Distributed a record high dividend of EUR 86.1 million (EUR 0.14 per share) to shareholders in May 2026 for the year 2025, following the Annual General Meeting's decision.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'in May 2026, we have distributed EUR 86.1 million as dividends to the shareholders of Telia Lietuva for the year 2025. It was a record high EUR 0.14 dividend per share payout'; Dividends section confirms amount and payment timing.

key_information_units.information: Commenced construction of a new Tier III standard data center near Vilnius in 2026, planning to invest up to EUR 26 million in two initial modules with 400 racks to be completed by the second half of 2027.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Plans and forecasts section: 'To meet today’s demand and prepare infrastructure for the future technologies at the beginning of 2026 the Company commenced construction of a new Tier III standard data center near Vilnius... The Company plans to invest up to EUR 26 million into the first two data center modules... to be completed by the second half of 2027'

key_information_units.information: Vaidas Dominauskas was appointed Head of Enterprise (B2B) effective 1 July 2026, succeeding Aurimas Žlibinas.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'A further change in the Company’s management took effect on 1 July 2026. Vaidas Dominauskas was appointed Head of Enterprise, succeeding Aurimas Žlibinas'; Governing structure section confirms the change.
